basics.name: Naazneen Shafeer Vemmerath Kulangara
basics.label: Physics Undergraduate & Researcher
basics.summary: Aspiring physicist and undergraduate researcher at the University of Southern California, specializing in cosmology and astrophysics.

work.name: USC Cosmology Research Lab
work.summary: Collaborating with Prof. Kris Pardo and Ph.D. student Mya Do to refine theoretical models, focusing on dynamical friction and dual AGN visualization.

work.name: USC Society of Physics Students
work.summary: Lead extracurricular initiatives, organize events connecting physics students across Greater Los Angeles, and foster networking opportunities.

work.name: Evergreen Goodwill, Seattle, WA
work.summary: Served as President of the Student Council, led a team of 15 peers, coordinated aerospace networking events, and developed a startup concept for lightweight aircraft seats.

projects.name: Cosmology Research
projects.summary: Simulating supermassive black hole binary mergers and analyzing unresolved components of dynamical friction in these systems.

projects.name: Astrophysics Research
projects.summary: Investigated black hole GRS 1915+105 and modeled the feasibility of stable planetary orbits in X-ray binary systems.
